summary: EasyEffects is an audio effects manager for Linux that provides GUI and CLI controls for equalization, dynamics, and spatial processing via PipeWire or ALSA. It is built as an open‑source tool hosted on GitLab and can be run locally without an API key. It targets Linux users who want to improve laptop speaker sound quality, especially those adopting PipeWire. The main strength is its flexible UI options, while the lack of package distribution and limited test coverage are notable drawbacks.
